underside.description: Same composition as upper wing; not documented in the owner's photographs

scallops.source: Jensen plan trailing-edge silhouette; depth and regular spacing simplified

materials.note: Profiles in ugly_stik_finish.gd; roughness chosen by comparable captures, not measured BRDF. US-V09a: glossy film (roughness 0.2, specular 0.5); US-V09b: film-over-structure normal map from film_structure

rasterization: Godot SVG Image.load_svg_from_string from compiled source at atlas_size_px (artwork in a 1024 viewBox), mipmaps, linear anisotropic; same SVG checked in for editing/import comparison; no editor cache required at runtime

film_structure.source: Jensen oz1253 sheet 2, bottom view of left wing, local 100 dpi raster (references/ugly-stik/downloads/jensen/Das_Ugly_Stik_Jensen_oz1253.pdf); column/row darkness profiles 2026-10-13
film_structure.method: Rib centres in plan inches from the centre line; metres scale them so tip rib W5 equals geometry tip_start (factor 0.9797, the known scan-scale residual). Chord fractions use the drawing's leading edge to scallop tips, rescaled so its hinge line (0.907) equals geometry hinge_fraction.
film_structure.false_ribs: W6 midway between adjacent main ribs, leading edge to secondary spar

sag.law: depth x (short side / reference)^2, sin x sin profile per open bay, film sags inward on both skins
sag.note: Normal map only; geometry, contacts and aerodynamics unchanged

fuselage_unwrap.note: US-V09e: fuselage sides and belly unwrapped; U along the fuselage, V = skin arc length s from the belly centre line, +X (exhaust) side positive. The flat top keeps the dorsal region; end caps keep plain red.

exhaust_residue.source: Glow two-stroke oil carried aft by the exhaust (owner request 2026-10-13). Outlet from the engine build: x 0.064, y -0.023, z -0.309 m, pointing aft, down and outboard.
exhaust_residue.note: Path, spread and fade are visual estimates of a used sport model, not measured residue. Set enabled false for a factory-clean finish.

stab.note: Spray that reaches the tail settles on the right stabiliser underside near the fuselage, strongest at the leading edge.

stab_unwrap.note: US-V09f: underside of the stabiliser and elevator (prism-local x span, z from the elevator hinge, negative forward). Top faces and edges keep plain red.

hatch.source: Jensen oz1253 sheet 1 side view, local 100 dpi raster: 1/4 in sheet hatch from the fuselage front to 5.40 in aft, ahead of the fixed top piece bevelled into the wing saddle (wing leading edge 6.98 in, model 0.176 m).
hatch.note: The rear seam coincides with fuselage station 1; the side seams follow the flat-top edges where the 1/4 in sides meet the rounded corners.

belly_wear.source: Tricycle-gear grass field use (owner request 2026-10-13): wheel-thrown grass and soil behind the nose wheel, light scuffs between the gears, tail-strike scrapes at the tail end.
belly_wear.note: Set enabled false for an unflown finish.
